keyword_evidence: Marketplace and retail evidence supports personalized teacher doormats, classroom welcome mats, back-to-school classroom decor, custom teacher name rugs and composition/notebook style mats. B031 separates near-duplicate classroom welcome mats by visible phrase, color palette and icon style.
buyer_summary: B031 buyers include teachers decorating classroom doors, school staff preparing back-to-school entrances, parents buying teacher appreciation gifts and educators who want a personalized welcome mat with a clear class identity.
purchase_concerns: Teacher name spelling, apostrophe/classroom text accuracy, color/style match, size fit, indoor entry use, non-slip backing, absorbency/easy-clean expectations and avoiding duplicate-looking designs.
